info.title: Cocodif
info.description: Diff-coverage reporter for .NET — generates PR-friendly Markdown/JSON reports from OpenCover or Cobertura XML coverage data.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Diff-coverage reporter — parses coverage XML and reports coverage on changed files

options.name: --coverage
options.description: Path(s) to coverage XML file(s) (OpenCover or Cobertura)

options.name: --format
options.description: Coverage format: opencover, cobertura, or auto [default: auto]

options.name: --changed-files
options.description: Path to file containing list of changed files (one per line)

options.name: --root
options.description: Repository root for normalizing absolute paths to repo-relative

options.name: --include
options.description: Glob pattern for files to include [default: **/*]

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Glob pattern for files to exclude [default: **/obj/**,**/bin/**]

options.name: --output-format
options.description: Output format: markdown, json, or both [default: markdown]

options.name: --fail-under
options.description: Fail (exit code 1) if overall diff coverage is below this percentage
